title: Normal tensor components realized as embedded joins
statement: Let $P$ be a normal integral domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], let $K=\operatorname{Frac}(P)$, fix a separable closure $K^{\mathrm{sep}}/K$ [def-kun-separably-closed], and let $\mathfrak q_1,\mathfrak q_2\subset P$ be prime ideals. Put $H_i=P^h_{\mathfrak q_i}$ for ordinary henselizations [def-weil-pbc-henselization-at-prime] and $T=H_1\otimes_P H_2$. For each nonempty connected component $Z\subset\operatorname{Spec}T$, take its component ring $U=T/I_Z$ with $I_Z$ generated by the idempotents vanishing on $Z$ [lem-trf-affine-etale-cover-component-criterion]. Then $U$ is a normal integral domain, $P\to U$ and the two maps $H_i\to U$ are injective, and $\operatorname{Frac}(U)/K$ is separable algebraic. There is a $P$-embedding $U\hookrightarrow K^{\mathrm{sep}}$. Under this embedding $U$ is precisely the subring generated by the images of $H_1$ and $H_2$. Each canonical homomorphism $H_i\to U$ is ind-etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra].
